newsitem.title: USA: U.S. 3-mo, 6-mo bills seen sold at 4.97, 5.07 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. 3-mo, 6-mo bills seen sold at 4.97, 5.07 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $15.0 billion in three- and six-month bills on Monday was expected to garner average discount rates of 4.97 percent and 5.07 percent, respectively, market participants said.
In when-issued trade at about 1245 EDT/1645 GMT, the three-month bill was at 4.965 percent, while the six-month bill was at 5.065 percent.
Dealers said they expected decent demand, but bidding may be less than in prior weeks.
The bidding deadline for the auction is 1300 EDT/1700 GMT. Results were expected around 1345 EDT/1745 GMT.
